name: See Ya, Scallywags!
summary: A wharfmaster has a plan for the Eastsea’s three boats. You are to plant timed charges in their hulls, then leave him to set them off.

sections.title: Charges Aboard
sections.body: The wharfmaster puts the gunpowder you stole to use, making timed charges for the Eastsea’s boats. You are to place one in the hull of each vessel, near its cannons. Once they are set, get clear so he can trigger the explosives.

faq.q: What does the wharfmaster want me to do?
aliases: what am i supposed to do
faq.answer: Plant a remote explosive charge in the hull of each of the Eastsea’s three boats, near the cannons.

faq.q: Why use the gunpowder I stole?
faq.answer: The wharfmaster uses the gunpowder to make timed charges for the boats.

faq.q: Why plant the charges near the cannons?
faq.answer: The wharfmaster says the gunpowder will make the explosives more powerful near the cannons.
You are to place charges on each of the Eastsea’s three boats.

faq.q: What does the wharfmaster know about explosives?
faq.answer: He says he used to make a less honest living.

attribution: In-game quest text: See Ya, Scallywags!
